n. forward projecting part of the head of certain animals; includes the jaws and nose

v. fit with a muzzle

n. 动物之鼻口, 口套, 枪口

n. A firearm which receives its charge through the
   muzzle, as distinguished from one which is loaded at the breech.

muzzle-loading.definition: a (of firearms) taking the projectile or cartridge through the muzzle

muzzles.definition:
n the open circular discharging end of a gun
n forward projecting part of the head of certain animals; includes the jaws and nose
n a leather or wire restraint that fits over an animal's snout (especially a dog's nose and jaws) and prevents it from eating or biting
n restraint put into a person's mouth to prevent speaking or shouting
v fit with a muzzle
v prevent from speaking out
v tie a gag around someone's mouth in order to silence them
muzzles.translation:
n. 枪口( muzzle的名词复数 ); （防止动物咬人的）口套; （四足动物的）鼻口部; （狗）等凸出的鼻子和口
v. 给（狗等）戴口套( muzzle的第三人称单数 ); 使缄默, 钳制…言论

muzzling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Muzzle
muzzling.translation: v. 给（狗等）戴口套( muzzle的现在分词 ); 使缄默, 钳制…言论

muzzy.definition:
s indistinct or hazy in outline
s confused and vague; used especially of thinking
muzzy.translation: a. 发呆的, 无精神的, 含糊的
